questions.stem: What makes stem cells different from other body cells?

options.text: Stem cells are only found in embryos and nowhere else
Stem cells contain more DNA than other cells
Stem cells can divide and differentiate into many different specialised cell types
Stem cells are larger than all other cells

questions.explanation: Stem cells are unspecialised cells with the unique ability to both self-renew (produce more stem cells) and differentiate into various specialised cell types, such as nerve cells, blood cells, or muscle cells.
